The Microscopic Brain-Eater Hiding in Water

Dive deep into the terrifying world of Naegleria fowleri, the 'brain-eating amoeba' found in warm freshwater. Learn how this microscopic organism causes a rapidly fatal infection by entering the brain through the nose, consuming tissue from the inside out. 🦠🧠 How can such a tiny creature be so devastatingly deadly?
